_NOTE: This dataset was designed for a Lookup activity pattern that required a Delta Lake linked service (AzureDatabricksDeltaLake). Since that linked service is not available, the ForEach pipelines were redesigned to use a DatabricksNotebook activity (ls_databricks) instead. The notebook nb_list_active_sources reads the control table and returns a JSON array string — no separate dataset needed. This file is kept only as a reference and should NOT be imported into ADF.
